thread:
mel: Quick sync — I opened a PR to add a compact migration example for the Optimize toolkit (batching + KV prefetch + quant profiles). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8342. TL;DR: short-seq workloads should prefer smaller batch sizes with kv-prefetch on, and use the 4-bit GPTQ profile in the profile table. Asking for: review, link fixes, and a tiny SDK snippet update.

anuj: taking a look. One quick Q — where do you want the snippet? under /optimize/migration or the SDK examples page?

mel: put it under /optimize/migration and add a crosslink on the SDK examples page. Also need a short note about expected latency tradeoffs.

sarah: I can handle the crosslink + anchor IDs. Will also run link-checker locally. @tom can you run the sample against CI? :eyes: 

tom: yep, running tests now. docs-bot: link-check failed on PR 8342 — missing anchor in /sdk/examples (reported by docs-ci)

mel: ah, ok thanks. I forgot to add the anchor. I'll patch.

mel: patch pushed — updated PR 8342 with anchor #kv-prefetch-quickstart and clarified the quant-profile table.

anuj: small SDK suggestion: replace 'batch_size=64' with heuristic code that picks based on seq len. Suggestion:

```python
# choose batch size based on median sequence length
import statistics
median_seq = statistics.median(seq_lengths)
batch_size = 32 if median_seq > 128 else 64
client.generate(..., batch_size=batch_size, kv_prefetch=True)
```

jun: nit: in the quant table, label the 4-bit profile as 'gptq-4-perf' so users don't confuse it with legacy q4_0.

sarah: link-check passed locally after mel's anchor fix. I'll request an approve from product docs reviewers.

docs-bot: PR 8342 — 2 approvals needed. autobumper: no conflicts.

tom: smoke-tested the snippet end-to-end on staging runtime, perf numbers look as documented (p95 latency ~120ms for short seq).

mel: awesome — thanks team. Next steps: sarah to add crosslink PR, anuj to update SDK snippet, jun to update quant table name. We can merge after 2 approves and green CI. :tada: 

sarah: will open small follow-up PR for crosslink within the hour.

anuj: I'll push the SDK tweak shortly.

mel: wrapping up — I'll add a one-line blurb to the migration checklist referencing this example.
